name: Rosa Delgado
role: School nurse and parent of three
goals: Buy things that are safe for kids and easy to clean
Avoid gadgets that need constant charging
quit_triggers: No safety, materials or age-range information
Battery life or charging not explained
Pushy countdown timers or fake scarcity

name: Kenji Watanabe
role: Product manager who reads every spec
goals: Compare options quickly and pick the best value
Know exactly what ships in the box
quit_triggers: No comparison with alternatives or clear differentiator
Missing dimensions, specs or what's included
Signup required before seeing the price

name: Gloria Mensah
goals: Find thoughtful gifts that are simple to use
Buy from companies she can call if something goes wrong
quit_triggers: Small low-contrast text she can't read
No phone number, address or real company name
Checkout that asks for an account

name: Tyler Brooks
role: College student on a tight budget
goals: Get the cheapest option that still works
Use Apple Pay or a fast checkout
quit_triggers: Price not visible in the first screen
Shipping cost revealed only at checkout

name: Amara Okafor
role: Procurement lead at a mid-size company
goals: Verify the vendor is real before any purchase
quit_triggers: Unverifiable testimonials or no social proof
No way to contact sales or get an invoice

name: Lucas Ferreira
goals: Buy durable gear that survives real use
quit_triggers: Only illustrations, no real product photos or demo
Layout breaks or overlaps on mobile
